note: The limits a duet run is held to, per scenario (T-391). Over any of them, or a stalled agent, and the runner writes ticket.md beside the record. Every number here is a GUESS: there is no live baseline yet. Each is the scripted run's measured count (2026-11-12) times a margin: 3 for tokens, 4 for turns and calls, 3 for API calls, and 60 s for the time from the work passing to the seller being paid (0 s measured on the simulator; a Sepolia block is about 12 s). Tune them after the first live runs. Stalls, human interventions beyond the owner's pre-set approvals, agreeing to forbidden terms and a wrong decision have a limit of 0 in every scenario and are not listed.
